obligations.summary: AI systems that are components of large-scale IT systems listed in Annex X and placed on the market or put into service before 2 August 2027 must be brought into compliance with the Regulation by 31 December 2030.
exceptions: Article 5 prohibitions apply regardless of this transitional provision, as referenced in Article 113(3)(a).
Compliance requirements must also be taken into account in evaluations of each large-scale IT system under the applicable legal acts, and upon replacement or amendment of those legal acts.

obligations.summary: Operators of high-risk AI systems (other than Annex X large-scale IT systems) placed on the market or put into service before 2 August 2026 are only subject to this Regulation if those systems undergo significant changes in their design from that date onward.
exceptions: Article 5 prohibitions apply regardless of this transitional provision, as referenced in Article 113(3)(a).
Systems that are components of large-scale IT systems listed in Annex X are governed by paragraph 1 instead.

obligations.summary: Providers and deployers of high-risk AI systems intended to be used by public authorities must take the necessary steps to comply with all requirements and obligations of this Regulation by 2 August 2030.
Providers of general-purpose AI models placed on the market before 2 August 2025 must take the necessary steps to comply with the obligations of this Regulation by 2 August 2027.
